🧪 Testing Checklist

Verify every change

1. Font Size
All text larger — body 16px, nav 12px.

2. Dashboard Task Widget
Login as staff → Dashboard shows "My Tasks Today" card.

3. Edit Task
Tasks → tap task → "✏️ Edit Task" → change → Save.

4. Future Task Schedule
Tasks → Templates → New → set Start Date to future.

5. Task Report
Tasks → 📊 Report → set dates → Go → see staff chart.

6. Delete Completed
Tasks → Report → "🗑 Delete Completed" → Range/Month/Year/All → Delete.

7. Delete Lead
Leads → tap lead → "🗑 Delete Lead" (admin only).

8. Lead Status Saves Instantly
Open lead → tap Won → saves + moves to Won tab.

9. Forgot Password
Login → "Forgot Password?" → enter username → resets to admin123.

10. Forgot Username
Login → "Forgot Username?" → shows all usernames.

11. Admin Locked Out
"Admin locked out?" → 3 working recovery options.

12. Auto-Sync 30s
Change on PC → wait 30s on Android → auto-refreshes.

13. 🔄 Refresh
Dashboard → tap 🔄 → instant pull from server.

14. Logout Saves
Logout → "Save & sync?" → syncs to Google Sheets → logs out.

15. Google Sheets Sync
Every save pushes to Google Sheets automatically.

16. GST Lookup
Customers → GSTIN → GST Lookup → opens gstin.in.

17. Supplier GSTIN
Suppliers → Add → GSTIN field present → saves.

18. WA Reminders
Tasks → All → "📲 Send WA Reminders Now" → WA per staff.

📋 Google Apps Script

Follow these steps to connect your Google Sheet:

  1. Open your Google Sheet → click Extensions → Apps Script
  2. Delete any existing code in the editor
  3. Click Copy Script below and paste it into the editor
  4. Click Save (Ctrl+S), give the project a name (e.g. ALT Stock)
  5. Click Deploy → New deployment
  6. Select type: Web app
  7. Set Execute as: Me and Who has access: Anyone
  8. Click Deploy → copy the Web App URL (ends in /exec)
  9. Paste that URL into Step 3 on the Database tab and save
  10. Click Test Connection to verify everything works
